comparisons.peer_topic: Fair value option election for short-term structured liabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation elects to account for certain short-term borrowings, primarily short-term structured liabilities, under the fair value option because this debt is risk-managed on a fair value basis.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup (C) and Bank of America (BAC) disclose the election of the fair value option for specific debt instruments. C reports that short-term borrowings and long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where the Company has elected to report debt instruments (including certain structured notes) at fair value. Similarly, BAC elects to account for certain short-term borrowings, primarily short-term structured liabilities, under the fair value option because this debt is risk-managed on a fair value basis. While C's disclosure focuses on the general accounting policy exception for structured notes, BAC specifies the operational rationale (risk management) for similar structured liability electives.

sentences.text: Short-term borrowings and Long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where the Company has elected to report the debt instruments (including certain structured notes) at fair value, or debt that is in a fair value hedging relationship.
The Corporation elects to account for certain short-term borrowings, primarily short-term structured liabilities, under the fair value option because this debt is risk-managed on a fair value basis.

comparisons.peer_summary: Fair value adjustments from de-designated long-term debt and AFS debt securities hedges decreased the respective carrying values by significant amounts at December 31, 2024 and 2023, with adjustments being amortized or accreted into interest over contractual lives.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies address the accounting mechanics for debt instruments where fair value changes or adjustments impact the carrying value and subsequent interest expense. C states that changes in fair value of debt instruments carried at fair value are recorded in Principal transactions, with credit adjustments in OCI, and that premiums/discounts for amortized cost debt are amortized using the effective interest method. BAC discloses that fair value adjustments from de-designated hedges on long-term debt decreased carrying values and that these adjustments are amortized or accreted into interest over the contractual lives. Both disclosures illustrate the interaction between fair value adjustments/hedging and the amortization or interest expense recognition over the life of the debt.

sentences.text: Changes in the fair value of debt instruments carried at fair value under a fair value election are recorded in Principal transactions, other than adjustments related to changes in the Company's credit, which are recorded in Other comprehensive income.
Premiums, discounts and issuance costs on long-term debt accounted for at amortized cost are amortized over the contractual term using the effective interest method.
At December 31, 2024 and 2023, the fair value adjustments from de-designated long-term debt hedges decreased the long-term debt carrying value by $11.2 billion and $10.5 billion.
The fair value adjustments are being amortized or accreted into interest over the contractual lives of the assets or liabilities.

comparisons.peer_topic: Accounting treatment of certain unsecured short-term borrowings at fair value
comparisons.peer_summary: The firm accounts for certain hybrid financial instruments classified as unsecured short-term borrowings at fair value under the fair value option, with carrying values of non-fair-value borrowings approximating fair value due to short-term nature.
comparisons.comparison: Goldman Sachs (GS) and Citigroup (C) both disclose the accounting treatment for short-term borrowings where fair value option elections are made versus those carried at amortized cost. C states that short-term borrowings and long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where fair value elections are made for instruments like structured notes. GS accounts for certain hybrid financial instruments classified as unsecured short-term borrowings at fair value under the fair value option, while noting that the carrying value of other unsecured short-term borrowings not recorded at fair value generally approximates fair value. Both highlight the coexistence of fair value option electives and standard amortized cost or approximated fair value treatments for short-term liabilities.

sentences.text: Short-term borrowings and Long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where the Company has elected to report the debt instruments (including certain structured notes) at fair value, or debt that is in a fair value hedging relationship.
The firm accounts for certain hybrid financial instruments at fair value under the fair value option.
The carrying value of unsecured short-term borrowings that are not recorded at fair value generally approximates fair value due to the short-term nature of the obligations.

comparisons.peer_summary: JPMorgan Chase issues long-term debt in various currencies, predominantly U.S. dollars, with fixed and variable rates, including equity-linked instruments measured at fair value with gains/losses recorded in principal transactions revenue or OCI.
comparisons.comparison: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) and Citigroup (C) both identify specific categories of long-term debt that are measured at fair value under election. C notes exceptions to amortized cost where the Company elected to report debt instruments (including certain structured notes) at fair value. JPM states that equity-linked or other indexed instruments included in senior and subordinated debt are elected to be measured at fair value, with changes in fair value recorded in principal transactions revenue or OCI. Both disclosures confirm the use of fair value measurement for complex or equity-linked long-term debt instruments rather than strictly amortized cost.

sentences.text: Short-term borrowings and Long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where the Company has elected to report the debt instruments (including certain structured notes) at fair value, or debt that is in a fair value hedging relationship.
Included in senior and subordinated debt below are various equity-linked or other indexed instruments, which the Firm has elected to measure at fair value.
Changes in fair value are recorded in principal transactions revenue in the Consolidated statements of income, except for unrealized gains/(losses) due to DVA which are recorded in OCI.
